Core_Claim: Automotive software integration suffers from massive traceability decay between requirements, ARXML, and C source code
Hostile_Counterargument_Check: Documented across industry: ALM tools struggle when explicit links break during continuous integration.

Core_Claim: Existing middleware (DDS, SOME/IP, ROS 2) solves data communication and syntax but does NOT solve semantic capability reasoning
Hostile_Counterargument_Check: IDL formats specify data layout and types (floats, structs) but cannot express operational capability bounds or safety assumptions.

Core_Claim: V2X standards (SAE J2735) broadcast basic vehicle kinematics but do not support dynamic capability contract negotiation
Hostile_Counterargument_Check: BSM and CAM messages broadcast speed, position, heading; they cannot negotiate degraded sensing modes or braking clearance contracts.

Core_Claim: Waymo and Tesla represent closed, vertically integrated proprietary ecosystems with zero cross-OEM autonomous interoperability
Hostile_Counterargument_Check: Neither company provides external semantic APIs for third-party coordination; interaction is purely through visual/radar physical behavior.

Core_Claim: AURA-Impact achieves 63.11% artifact recall and 82.29% test suite reduction with 100% safety invariant enforcement inside a single system
Hostile_Counterargument_Check: Proven on 150 automated mutation batches on synthetic benchmark; does not prove multi-agent interoperability or OEM production scale.

Core_Claim: AURA can automatically evolve into an inter-system protocol that allows heterogeneous autonomous systems to interoperate seamlessly
Hostile_Counterargument_Check: Hostile objection: Internal software artifact dependency is fundamentally different from real-time physical multi-agent coordination.

Core_Claim: A decentralized blockchain ledger is necessary for cross-system autonomous interoperability
Hostile_Counterargument_Check: Blockchain introduces unacceptable latency (>100ms), massive compute overhead, and unnecessary complexity. Peer-to-peer federated discovery suffices.

Core_Claim: The 'UPI for Autonomous Systems' analogy is fully applicable to autonomous vehicle coordination
Hostile_Counterargument_Check: Analogy works at API routing/decoupling level, but fails completely on physical safety, real-time latency (<10ms vs 2s), and continuous dynamics.

Core_Claim: An Architectural Context Gate can eliminate semantic hallucinations in cross-system capability discovery
Hostile_Counterargument_Check: Context filter strictly rejected 100% of out-of-subsystem decoys locally; extension to multi-vendor ontologies requires formal verification.

Core_Claim: A non-bypassable safety gate (T_safe SUBSET_OF T_selected) can be extended to inter-system capability contracts (C_safe SUBSET_OF C_contract)
Hostile_Counterargument_Check: Mathematical subset enforcement is verified locally; cross-agent enforcement requires mutual trust and verifiable cryptographic attestations.
